expectations.evidence: The Customer Goal column consistently translates each vendor-funnel stage into a job stated from the engineer's side: "Pin down why current visibility failed and whether fixing it is worth a project," "Prove it works in their environment, at their scale, with no surprises, before it touches anything real," "Get sign-off, cut over to production without an incident, and be able to defend the choice in six months," and "Get credit for the call, spread it to other teams, and stop being the single point of failure for it."
